page.content:
God of the lyre, plague, and prophetic light.

How Apollo connects

  • Location: Delphi — Apollo's chief oracle speaks at Delphi.
  • Character: Artemis — Artemis and Apollo are Leto's twin archers.

What is Apollo?

Apollo is the far-shooter: music, healing, and the oracle at Delphi. He and Artemis are Leto's twins; he slays the Python and speaks through the Pythia.

Key threads lead to Delphi and Artemis.
